notes.title: Version 1.4 Update & Additional Content
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone, this is Kago, the developer.
This is the final update for the game [i]Demon Goblin and Mr. Knight[/i], which adds long rest CGs for six specific outfits.[/p][p]Now, when Lilly is equipped with a matching outfit and takes a long rest at a field camp, a special event will be triggered, replacing the standard long rest with a unique animation.[/p][p][/p][p]For example:[/p][list][*][p]Equip the [b]Goblin Warrior Mask[/b] and the [b]Goblin Shaman's Nipple Rings[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529467/1a268f7afe417ce535bbbcbe0471a89bebd8bd0b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529467/389a0d56d3ab66fa4d96a465493585f60bd0f02f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, the corresponding outfits will grant extra stat boosts after completing a long rest, so please make good use of them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tip:[/b][/p][p]To trigger the special CG events, you need to equip items from the same outfit series.[/p][p]There are three equipment slots: [b]Head[/b], [b]Body[/b], and [b]Accessory[/b].[/p][p]Some outfit sets include only Head and Body items—in such cases, as long as both are from the same series, the CG will still trigger even if the Accessory is mismatched.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b][/p][p]The Rabbit Ear Hood is an exception.[/p][p]As long as Lilly is wearing the Rabbit Ear Hood in the Head slot, its special CG will always trigger regardless of other equipment.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529467/358215613c203689ae50849098433a313b72966b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529467/5d1cfd4542dd8339b367e0203861785fe98d2617.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]However, some outfits [b]require all three equipment slots[/b]—Head, Body, and Accessory—to be equipped in order to trigger the CG event. Please keep this in mind.[/p][p]Additionally, considering the timing of unlocking events in Lilly’s Memory Room, the new CG events added in this update will be [b]automatically unlocked[/b] in the Memory Room. You do not need to trigger them on the map.[/p][p]Finally, thank you all for your continued support.
This is the [b]final content update[/b], and it’s about time to move on to the next project.
I hope the next game will also live up to your expectations.[/p][p]By the way, I’d also like to apologize to those who were looking forward to the cloud save feature...[/p][p]For some reason, even after all this time testing, the cloud functionality still isn’t working properly.[/p][p]During earlier tests, the cloud sync prompt did show up successfully, but the save files just wouldn’t upload no matter what I tried.[/p][p]I’m still not sure what went wrong, and after spending a lot of time trying to fix it... I’ve decided to give up on it for this game.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.3 – What's New
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone. This is Kago.
To thank you all for your support of my first solo-developed game, I’ve decided to release an additional content update.
However, since the development of the sequel has already been confirmed, I’ve kept the added content limited to avoid any spoilers or implications related to the sequel’s story.
I hope you understand, and thank you for your continued support.

Version 1.3 Additional Events

[olist]
[*] Triggered at the camp merchant after studying the Earthmother's Tome.
[*] After triggering the merchant event, you’ll receive a new item. With this item in your possession, passing through water areas may trigger an additional event.
[*] After defeating Master Ena, a new event can be triggered at the camp with her.

[*] There is a chance of triggering a special event with Ena upon defeat.
Additional outfit included—automatically obtained after completing the merchant event.
You can also directly unlock the new CG from the June update in the Recollection Room.[/olist]

Additional Outfit Events – When Lilly wears specific outfits and takes a long rest in the resting area, corresponding CG events can be triggered.

notes.title: HOT FIX 1.20
notes.notes:
看到有人表示那個升級確認太拖遊戲節奏，我也知道，但之前的遊戲系統如果不加個緩衝會導致事件發生衝突，發售後花了些時間重新研究了下，今天算是成功，所以就順便更新囉！

あのレベルアップの確認がゲームのテンポを崩しているという声を見かけました。私も分かっていましたが、以前のシステムではバッファを入れないとイベントが衝突してしまう問題がありました。発売後に少し時間をかけて再調整して、今日ついにうまくいったので、ついでにアップデートしました！

I saw some people mention that the level-up confirmation was slowing down the game’s pace. I knew it too, but with the previous system, not having a buffer would’ve caused event conflicts. After release, I spent some time revisiting it, and today I finally got it working—so I’ve gone ahead and updated it!
[list]
[*] 移除升級時的確認要求，現在會直接演示完升級動畫
[*] レベルアップ時の確認を削除し、すぐにレベルアップ演出が再生されるようになりました
[*] Removed the confirmation prompt during leveling up; the upgrade animation now plays automatically
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Sorry, I only just saw the Steam review message today and noticed a few issues, which have now been fixed.

A bug where the thank-you screen after clearing the trial version could not be dismissed

The unclear location of the language setting

Regarding the latter, there isn’t much I can do at the moment, so I’ve changed the “Options” label on the title screen to display as “Language / Sound Settings” in hopes of making it clearer and more convenient.
Apologies for this clumsy workaround—it's due to my limited technical skills.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529467/6a4fab53aa56b916e896c03933fcc49f686ff8a5.jpg[/img]
